defects.quote: they account for all 3688 errors in the window
defects.why: The checkout count is whole-run transaction data, whereas 3688 is also the policy-window count, so matching totals do not establish that checkout accounts for the window's errors.
The evidence explicitly has unspecified stages and supplies no run-phase structure.
The aggregates report maximum values but not how many samples reached those maxima.

notes: It contains many sound, actionable caveats, but its central checkout-in-window attribution and unsupported phase and uniqueness language could mislead an operator.
